channel.title: ETEnergyWorld - Oil and Gas
channel.description: Latest Oil and Gas News from ETEnergyWorld

item.title: ONGC awards deepwater rig charter contract worth Rs 1,450 crore for KG-DWN-98/2 block
item.description: State-run ONGC has awarded a major ultra-deepwater drillship charter hire contract operating at water depths exceeding 2,100 metres in the KG-DWN-98/2 basin to bolster offshore crude oil and natural gas production.

item.title: DGH opens international bidding for OALP Round X offering 28 offshore exploration blocks
item.description: The Directorate General of Hydrocarbons (DGH) has formally launched the OALP Round 10 international bidding round offering 28 ultra-deepwater and deepwater blocks across Andaman and Mahanadi offshore basins.

item.title: Petrol and diesel retail pump prices remain unchanged across metro cities
item.description: Fuel retailers state that retail petrol and diesel pump rates remain steady across Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai.
